name: Gordon Moore
notes: FALLBACK LAG, WORST CASE: Fairchild Semiconductor (a4, 1957) demonstrably passed $10M revenue around 1960-61, but no citable source pins the crossing year (Computer History Museum and Wikipedia give no early annual figures), and Fairchild Camera's 1959 buyout of the founders was ~$3M, below the acq50 threshold. The recorded hit is therefore Intel's 1971 IPO, roughly 11 years later than the true first hit. Treat this row as an upper bound.
